items.performers: Victoria de los Ángeles, Nicolai Gedda, Janine Micheau, Ernest Blanc; French Radio chorus and orchestra; Thomas Beecham
items.label: EMI / Warner Classics
items.note: The two acoustic arias in the Hall introduce Carmen and Escamillo separately. The complete opera supplies José’s Flower Song, the cards and the final duet, in which the refrain of the bullring crowd is heard during the murder scene. Beecham’s set is the first choice; de los Ángeles keeps the heroine’s phrases light and mobile, and Beecham gives the dances room.

items.work: Les Pêcheurs de perles — complete opera
items.performers: Nicolai Gedda; Opéra-Comique chorus and orchestra; Pierre Dervaux
items.label: EMI / Warner Classics
items.note: Warner’s page identifies this as the complete opera and not a highlights compilation. Beyond the famous friendship duet it has Nadir’s romance and the conflict around Leïla, a drama of jealousy and loyalty. Gedda sings Nadir, and Dervaux conducts at a theatrical pace; the recording is an introduction to Bizet’s earlier theatre.
